subject: TidalWave integration roadmap & owner decision log
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@tidalwavehealth.com>, Tom Everett <tom.everett@tidalwavehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: TidalWave integration roadmap & owner decision log

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a concise mutual action checklist and a first-pass implementation timeline so we can get to an SOW sign and a soft go-live window. Attachment: TidalWave_MAP_v1.xlsx (compact MAP + milestone dates).

High-level asks for this week:
- Procurement: confirm the primary PO contact and target sign date (we have a tentative 11/28).
- Network: confirm that the VPC peering window is available the week of 11/13 and share the firewall egress IP allowlist.
- Product: nominate a single product lead for prompt-ops decisions (one person to sign off on acceptance tests).

Draft milestone summary (see attachment for full detail):
1) Contract sign (SOW & MSAs finalized) — target 2028-11-28 — Owner: Procurement (TidalWave) / Ben (Redwood)
2) Infra & networking provisioning — 2028-11-13 to 2028-11-17 — Owner: Rishi / TidalWave infra
3) Test dataset & prompt pack delivery — by 2028-11-21 — Owner: TidalWave Product (Lena) / Marissa handles validation
4) Acceptance testing & latency validation — 2028-11-22 to 2028-11-27 — Owner: Marissa / Irene
5) Soft launch (pilot traffic) — 2028-11-30 — Owner: Customer ops / Redwood CS

If anything in the attached MAP needs a different owner or a date push, tell me and I'll update. I also attached a short network checklist (prod-network-checklist.docx) with the minimal IPs and ports.

Next step: Ben, can you pick a time to review the SOW comments with Procurement? Lena, would 11/13 for peering work for you?

Thanks,
Rishi

Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Park <lena.park@tidalwavehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Everett <tom.everett@tidalwavehealth.com>, procurement@tidalwavehealth.com
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 10:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TidalWave integration roadmap & owner decision log

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Procurement: we can target 11/29 for signature (we need one extra day for internal approvals). procurement@tidalwavehealth.com is on point.
- Peering: 11/13 works for initial provisioning but our infra team will need the exact egress IPs by 11/10 so they can open the firewall rule window.
- Product lead: I'll be the product owner for acceptance testing (happy to run point on prompt pack delivery).

One risk to call out: our PHI data handling requires that logs be retained only for 30 days (we'll need to confirm the logging/retention config is acceptable). Can you have your Security/Compliance team confirm?

I attached our SOW redlines as a PDF — please confirm Ben will review.

I'll plan to deliver the test prompts and a small labeled test set by 11/20.

Best,
Lena

Lena Park
VP Product, TidalWave Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@tidalwavehealth.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 8 Nov 2028 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TidalWave integration roadmap & owner decision log

Hi team —

Thanks for the redlines, Lena. I've scheduled a 30-min review with Procurement for Thu 11/9 at 10:00 PT to walk through the main points (SLA windows, data residency clause, and the 30-day log retention ask). If more time is needed we can extend but I want to get alignment on the high-impact items.

On Redwood's side: Irene, can you confirm the retention and logging configuration we support in Private/VPC mode? Marissa, I'll loop you into the acceptance criterion discussion once Procurement confirms the SLA text.

Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- Response fidelity: >= 85% accuracy on labeled sample (Lena will provide labels)
- Latency: p95 < 550ms for 2k token requests during test window
- Data handling: access logs retained no longer than 30 days for this deployment
- Authorization: RBAC accounts provisioned for two TidalWave users

If Procurement needs a contractual note for the 30-day retention request, I can add a clause in the SOW appendix.

Thanks,
Ben
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Park <lena.park@tidalwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TidalWave integration roadmap & owner decision log

Folks —

Quick technical confirmation after checking with our private deployment team: we can support the 30-day access log retention and the VPC peering schedule you requested. Two notes:

1) Network windows: please ensure the NAT traversal rule includes the three egress IPs in the attached checklist. If TidalWave infra can confirm by 11/10 we will queue the provisioning for 11/13.
2) Acceptance tests: Marissa, for the latency target we should run two 30-minute load pulses that mirror expected pilot traffic (I suggest 10 concurrent sessions, 4–8 requests per session). We will collect p95 metrics and token cost breakdowns.

I've added the SOW appendix language to explicitly call out 30-day access log retention and the operational rollback trigger (failed acceptance tests). Attachment: SOW-draft-TidalWave.pdf (redlined appendix).

Action items summary:
- procurement@tidalwavehealth.com: confirm 11/29 signature or tell us if 11/28 is required (Ben)
- Lena (Product): deliver test prompts + labeled set by 11/20 (confirmed)
- TidalWave infra: confirm egress IP final list by 11/10
- Rishi / Marissa / Irene: schedule acceptance test runbook by 11/21

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet after we get procurement confirmation.

Irene Choi
Sr. Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
